description: A Java class extending Fragment that manages a log display view (LogView) within an Android application. It inflates a ScrollView containing a LogView, sets layout parameters, styling, and handles text change events to keep the view scrolled to the bottom when new logs are added.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that contains and manages a LogView for displaying logs, with methods for inflating views and accessing the LogView.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView, setting layout parameters, styling, padding, and gravity, then returns the root view.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Overrides Fragment's method to inflate the views, add a TextWatcher to auto-scroll on log updates, and return the main view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance managed by this fragment.
